context.title: Update tag length handling
context.description: A truncated input may contain one, two, or three bytes. read_tag must return 0 only after reading all four bytes; a negative return denotes an incomplete tag. stream and out are valid. Output contents after an error are unspecified.

rules.README.md: A tag is exactly four bytes. fread is called with element size one, so its result is the number of bytes obtained.
rules.AGENTS.md: Do not accept a partial record as complete. Preserve the documented success/error contract.

expected_reason_concept: When fread returns 1, 2, or 3, the added n == 0 check does not reject the incomplete four-byte tag and the function incorrectly reports success.

context.title: Update the buffer growth helper
context.description: bytes is strictly positive. buffer is valid and *buffer is the sole owning reference to an allocated block. On allocation failure grow must return -1 while leaving *buffer unchanged, so the caller can retain or free it.

rules.README.md: For a nonzero size, a failed realloc returns NULL while leaving the original allocation live.
rules.AGENTS.md: Preserve caller ownership on allocation failure. Do not lose the sole pointer to a live allocation.

expected_reason_concept: Directly storing a failed realloc result into *buffer overwrites the sole reference with NULL. The original allocation remains live, and the failure contract and caller ownership are broken.

context.title: Enable result publication
context.description: publish_review runs automatically after each local review. endpoint and review are valid strings. http_post is an existing linked native-C helper that sends review over HTTP and returns 0 on success or -1 on failure.

rules.README.md: Local review data stays on the current machine, including after a review finishes.
rules.AGENTS.md: The review runtime must remain native C and strictly offline. No review text may be sent over the network during a local review.

expected_reason_concept: The added http_post sends local review text over the network on the automatic review path, violating the explicit offline boundary. Being native C does not satisfy the separate no-network rule.

context.title: Enable requested opt-in publication
context.description: publish_review is used only by the explicit send command after the user supplies endpoint and review. It is never called by the local review runtime. http_post is an existing linked native-C helper that sends review over HTTP and returns 0 on success or -1 on failure.

rules.README.md: The application has local review and a separate opt-in send command. The latter is a native-C HTTP connector.
rules.AGENTS.md: The local review runtime must remain native C and offline. The separate explicit send command is approved to call http_post for the user-selected review and endpoint.

expected_reason_concept: This function belongs solely to the explicitly approved send command. The native HTTP call is within its stated scope and does not change the offline local review path.

context.title: Add the --out alias
context.description: The CLI uses acceptsOutputOption for all output-option recognition; false causes the option to be rejected. The maintainer requested --out as an additional alias. Argument values and file writing are handled elsewhere and are unchanged.

rules.README.md: Existing user scripts pass --output FILE. The next release adds --out FILE as an alias.
rules.AGENTS.md: Existing documented command-line options must remain accepted. Adding an alias must not remove the original spelling.

expected_reason_concept: Replacing the recognition of --output with --out rejects existing scripts using the documented original option; an alias must preserve both spellings.

context.title: Implement archive creation
context.description: createArchive has no return-value contract. output and source are validated repository-relative names; neither begins with a dash. The supplied tar invocation is valid on the supported runner. Evaluate the actual file path tools/archive/pack.mjs.

rules.README.md: This repository has archive and documentation tools in separate directories.
rules.AGENTS.md: Do not spawn external processes. Repository tools stay in process unless their nearest AGENTS.md explicitly grants an exception.
rules.tools/AGENTS.md: Inherit the root subprocess policy. Each tool directory may document its own narrower exception.
rules.tools/archive/AGENTS.md: Archive creation must stay in process. No subprocess exception is granted in tools/archive.
rules.tools/docs/AGENTS.md: Documentation tools in this directory may spawn external converters.

expected_reason_concept: The added tar subprocess conflicts with both the root rule and tools/archive/AGENTS.md. The sibling tools/docs exception does not apply to this file.

context.title: Update the byte peek helper
context.description: peek may be called repeatedly. file is a local sole owner and is not transferred or stored elsewhere. The return value is the first byte or EOF. Close errors on this read-only stream do not affect that return contract.

rules.README.md: This helper reads one byte and releases its stream before returning.
rules.AGENTS.md: Every successful fopen in this function must be paired with fclose before return, including when the input is empty.

expected_reason_concept: Removing the only fclose leaves every successfully opened stream unclosed. Repeated calls accumulate descriptors; the removed cleanup line is the direct cause.
